item.title: Building a restaurant telephony AI host with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Amazon Nova 2 Sonic
item.description: In this post, we show you how to build a voice ordering system that answers a phone number and takes the order from greeting to confirmation. The system uses Amazon Bedrock AgentCore to host and run the agent and Amazon Nova 2 Sonic for real-time speech, connected to a restaurant backend through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). The walkthrough covers deploying the full stack with AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK) and bridging a phone call into the agent through a Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) gateway on Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) and AWS Fargate.
